name: Commerce Product Tax
description: Provides a user interface for selecting applicable tax rates on the product variation.
project_description:
Provides a user interface for selecting applicable tax rates on the product variation.

 By default, Commerce always selects the default tax rate for the resolved tax type and zone. This module provides a "Tax rate" field type and matching logic, which allows selecting a reduced rate or no rate, in case of tax free products.

 To get started, go to your product variation type, and create a "Tax rate" field. Then edit your product variation and select the desired tax rates. The field will be auto-detected by the module's resolver.
